summary: Candidate is a non-empty delta (2 files, 52 insertions / 19 deletions, hasDelta=true, verificationOnly=false) repairing the audited blocker of the trusted finalizer failure (Actions run 35515804944, step 7 'Android API 35 install, launch and golden path', failure after ~31m47s with steps 5 gates and 6 APK green, re-confirmed via the public GitHub API; job logs require admin rights, 403). The concrete blocker is the golden-path assertion phase: the previous accepted repair (cycle 35510712950) added a uiautomator warm-up dump at the end of launch() but cached it as { xml: warmupXml, nodes: [] } — an empty nodes array — so the first findNodes('Demarrer') in waitFor() spun on empty cache hits for up to the 30s TTL before triggering a real dump, wasting critical golden-path time on top of the 30-60s cold-start dump cost. Repair: scripts/e2e-android.js extracts parseNodesFromXml(xml) as a shared function (behavior-preserving: same regex, same decode, same empty/invalid guard) used by both dumpUi() and the warm-up block; the warm-up cache is now populated with real parsed nodes ({ xml: warmupXml, nodes: warmupNodes }) so the first findNodes() in waitFor('Demarrer') matches immediately when the Demarrer screen is captured by the warm-up dump, eliminating the 30s dead spin and the first real dump (30-60s) from the critical path. The stale contradictory comment in launch() was also replaced. No new adb calls were added (warm-up block remains rm + dump + cat = 3 calls, bounded ~91s worst case, try/catch best-effort with WARN-and-proceed). Static contract tests in __tests__/domain/v3-08-finalizer-wrapper.test.ts were updated/added to guard the parsed-nodes cache and the shared parseNodesFromXml usage; reverting the fix fails the assertions. Trusted verification exit 0: typecheck PASS, 448 tests/22 suites PASS, privacy 71 PASS, cost 21 PASS (10 gates), expo export/prebuild PASS, :app:assembleDebug BUILD SUCCESSFUL (19m50s). Independent re-verification: candidate patch byte-identical to staged diff; pristine tree differs only in the 2 candidate files; no control-plane file changed; typecheck PASS; full suite 448/448 PASS; privacy PASS; cost PASS; wrapper contract suite 18/18 PASS; node --check PASS; bash -n finalizer-e2e.sh PASS; workflow single-line script form intact; prohibited-pattern scan clean; simulation confirms parseNodesFromXml parses real nodes and findNodes('Demarrer') matches from the warm-up cache. No mustFix remains within Builder scope: the release-level mustFix's requiredFix (inspect the exact trusted finalizer failure and repair only the concrete blocker while preserving V3-01..V3-07) has been executed; the empirical gate is the next trusted finalizer run passing step 7.

findings.problem: The previous accepted repair cached the warm-up dump as { xml: warmupXml, nodes: [] } — an empty nodes array — so the first findNodes('Demarrer') in waitFor() could not match any node from the cache and spun on empty cache hits for up to the 30s TTL before triggering a real dump, adding up to 30s dead spin plus a 30-60s cold-start dump to the golden-path critical path. This was the audited informational finding of cycle 35510712950 and the concrete remaining inefficiency in the step-7 golden-path timing chain.
findings.evidence: Previous baseline line: '_dumpCache = { xml: warmupXml, nodes: [] }; _dumpCacheTime = Date.now();'. Candidate now: 'const warmupNodes = parseNodesFromXml(warmupXml); ... _dumpCache = { xml: warmupXml, nodes: warmupNodes };'. Simulation confirms the parsed cache yields a match for findNodes('Demarrer') immediately. dumpUi() and the warm-up block now share the same parseNodesFromXml(xml) function (same regex /<node\b([^>]*)\/?>(?:<\/node>)?/g, same decode, same empty/invalid guard).
findings.requiredFix: None — the fix is applied in this candidate. The warm-up cache now contains real parsed nodes, eliminating the 30s dead spin and the first real dump from the critical path when the Demarrer screen is captured by the warm-up dump.
findings.verification: Wrapper contract suite 18/18 PASS (updated warm-up test asserts warmupNodes cache + parseNodesFromXml(warmupXml); new test asserts parseNodesFromXml is used by both dumpUi and the warm-up block); simulation PASS; node --check PASS.

findings.problem: The concrete step-7 failure evidence of run 35515804944 (result.json, logcat-finalizer.txt, logcat-failure.txt, dumpsys-activities-failure.txt, logcat-wait-* dumps, UI dump XMLs) is echoed to the step logs, which require admin rights to download; the GitHub API returns 403 for job logs on this repository and the artifact upload step was skipped on failure. The repair therefore relies on the documented failure chain (uiautomator dump 30-60s cold-start failures and empty-cache dead spin exhausting waitFor windows) and the step-7 duration analysis (~31m47s, consistent with boot+install+launch succeeding and the golden path exhausting waitFor windows) rather than the exact log lines. Empirical confirmation that the repair resolves the blocker requires a subsequent trusted finalizer run passing step 7.
